items.q: What are the six traits of AI slop?
items.a: Overused words, **too general**, **says nothing**, repetitive, hallucinated, and **no tone of its own**.
No: slop **keeps scaling**, so it needs to be **measured and edited out**.

items.q: Why generate five drafts per task?
items.a: To measure **intra-model variability**: weaker models vary more.

items.q: What bias do LLM judges show?
items.a: They **prefer their own model family**, so mix judge families and add **human comparisons**.

items.q: How costly is changing one rubric line in Tone-Bench?
Which model should you pick for writing?
items.a: The one that is **least annoying to edit**, not the one that sometimes one-shots a great post.

items.q: How long should a writing prompt be?
items.a: **As long and detailed as possible**, with positive and **negative examples** and banned words.
Generate **many cheap drafts**, then have a **stronger model merge the best parts**.

items.q: How many AI review rounds help?
items.a: **One to three**; more loops **drift back into slop**.
